subject: A confession about the one feature I almost removed
preview_text: I built this app to solve my own problem. But I was about to make the same mistake everyone else makes...
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this. Honestly, I hate sending them. It feels like shouting into a void. But something happened yesterday that made me stop and think about why I built Smart Notes in the first place.

I was reviewing our usage data, and I noticed a pattern. 90% of users were only using the transcription. They'd record, get the summary, and close the app. They were missing the entire point. The real magic isn't in capturing the words. It's in what happens AFTER the meeting ends. I built this app because I kept forgetting action items I promised people. The shame of dropping the ball. The frantic searches through messy notes. The feature that solves this? Almost nobody uses it.

It's the Smart Search. Type one keyword from any meeting, ever, and it pulls up every mention, every decision, every action item tied to it. It's like having a photographic memory for every conversation. I was about to remove it because the data said 'low engagement.' Then I realized: people don't use it because they don't KNOW it transforms chaos into clarity.

Open the app right now. Tap the search icon. Type in a project name or a client's name. See every related note, decision, and task materialize in seconds. That's the secret weapon. Not just taking notes, but actually FINDING them. P.S. The next time someone says 'remind me what we decided,' you'll have the answer in 3 seconds. That feeling is why I built this.
